_note: The firm's own defaults, used when a client's setup leaves them blank. Depreciation: per asset class, method REDUCING_BALANCE / STRAIGHT_LINE / NONE and the rate in %. 20% reducing balance with a full year on additions is the most common rate in the firm's finished working papers; property is not given a default (land is not depreciated, buildings vary).
_freight_note: Freight and carriage on goods bought (carriage in): the firm's cost of sales code. the firm's final codes put it in 1100 Purchases on most clients; the chart's own line is 1711.
